changelog:
- Initial release of Functional Test Case Standard skill.
- Provides standardized guidelines for functional test case design and evaluation.
- Includes five in-depth requirement analysis methods and fifteen-plus test design techniques.
- Supports dual output formats: Markdown and XMind mindmap, with two export dimensions (Review and Execution).
- Offers automated user prompts for output format and export dimension selection.
- Implements timestamp-based version management for traceability.
